name: Let Go
summary:
You are trapped in a floating world woven from obsession and shackles.
Every platform here is a past you cannot let go, a fear you dare not face, or a self-imposed constraint you cling to tightly.
You do not need to fight. You do not need to save the world.
You only need to leap forward.
Every jump is an act of letting go;
Every landing is a moment of liberation.
Leap higher, move forward, until you reach that light—weightless and unbound.
When you stand at the end, you will understand:
